newsitem.title: USA: Florence, Ala., rejects $4 mln of GO bonds - paper.
newsitem.headline: Florence, Ala., rejects $4 mln of GO bonds - paper.

text.p: Voters in Florence, Ala., rejected two general obligation bond issues totalling $4 million, the Huntsville Times said Wednesday.
A proposal to finance the purchase of land for recreational facilities was rejected with 1,771 no votes and 733 yes votes in Tuesday's balloting.
A proposal to finance construction of a senior citizens center failed with 1,748 no votes and 763 yes votes.
If approved, the proposals would have renewed a 7 mill property tax.
